name: Tran Trung Hau
title: Web Developer
objective: Web Developer with 3+ years building monitoring dashboards, video analytics and data platforms for Smart City and industrial park clients, working across React, Angular and FastAPI.

Having joined products from their earliest phase, working directly with the PO before a BA was in place, I enjoy turning loose requirements into a clear product scope. My goal is to grow into a Product Owner role, where hands-on engineering experience helps me make realistic product decisions.

education.school: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education

skills.label: AI-assisted Dev
items: Claude Code (agentic coding, refactoring, code review)

highlights: Built web platforms for Smart City, industrial park and factory digital transformation, covering energy, environment, wastewater and security monitoring for large industrial parks in Binh Duong.
Joined in the early phase, before a BA was in place, and worked directly with the PO to analyze requirements and shape the product scope.
Owned the frontend and UI/UX across three concurrent products (React, Angular) and contributed to the FastAPI backend.
Worked day-to-day with AI, Data, BA and Automation teams to turn detection models, data pipelines and field requirements into product features.

projects.name: Video Analytics System (VMS)
highlights: Developed an API server to manage cameras, users and gateways, and to ingest high-volume event data.
Refactored the FastAPI backend from an unstructured codebase into a layered controller–service–repository architecture, making features easier to extend and maintain.
Optimized backend services by reducing algorithmic complexity and removing redundant processing steps, significantly shortening response times.
Built a multi-protocol camera player in React: HLS via hls.js by default, with MSE-over-WebSocket and MP4 fallbacks, running 32 live streams concurrently on one screen.
Kept live streams close to real time by speeding up playback or seeking to the live edge when latency drifted, and recovered from network and media errors with exponential-backoff retries.

Added per-stream playback stats (FPS, bitrate, latency, buffer, dropped frames) and overlaid AI detection rules (lines, polygons, traffic lanes) aligned to the actual video frame under any object-fit.
Displayed about 2,000 camera and event markers on an interactive map.

projects.name: Smart City
highlights: Designed the web theme and selected the UI libraries that became the standard for subsequent projects.
Built a multi-app web platform for environment, security and energy operations across buildings, factories, warehouses and industrial parks.

Standardized a frontend codebase carried over from earlier projects, originally built by another department: replaced a 10,000+ line SCSS file of per-class Ant Design overrides (colors, sizes, spacing) with theme tokens in Ant Design's ConfigProvider, and guided the team to theme through the provider.
Reorganized the project structure into clear pages, apis and utils modules, and introduced a dedicated hooks folder for shared logic.

Centralized manual data collection into the cloud with real-time dashboards, letting operators monitor very large industrial areas (Bau Bang, My Phuoc and Thoi Hoa industrial parks, and the Binh Duong Industrial–Service–Urban Complex) with fewer on-site staff.
Collaborated with BA and PO teams to design the UI/UX.

projects.name: Data Lake
highlights: Designed and implemented the frontend for a data lake management system that visualizes and manages large-scale structured and unstructured data: data catalog, schema inspection and pipeline status monitoring.
Built many form-heavy screens in Angular with consistent validation and error handling.
Created a set of reusable Angular components on top of Angular Material and Tailwind CSS, most notably a shared data table (sorting, filtering, pagination) reused across the whole app.
